summary.text: Joseph McNamara is a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, representing District 19 since 1995, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Independent Patrick Maloney Jr.

paragraphs.text: Joseph McNamara earned a B.S. from Boston University and an M.Ed. from Providence College, and his professional experience includes working as an administrator.
In the 2021-2022 session he chaired the House Education Committee and the Health, Education, and Welfare Committee.
